version.changelog:
- Initial release: enables transcription and audio intelligence for pre-recorded files and URLs using Gladia's async/batch API.
- Supports speaker diarization, PII redaction, subtitles, translation, summarization, chapterization, NER, and audio-to-LLM features.
- Strongly prefers official SDK methods (JS/Python) for file handling, with guidance to use REST API only as fallback.
- Includes full documentation for workflow, job management, options, polling best practices, and common mistakes.
- Documents limits (file size, duration, concurrency) and provides extensive troubleshooting and integration references.

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only skill for using Gladia transcription APIs, with the main consideration being that audio and transcripts may be sent to an external provider.

dimensions.detail: The described capabilities match the stated purpose: pre-recorded audio transcription, job management, subtitles, diarization, translation, PII redaction, summarization, and audio-to-LLM through Gladia.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to Gladia SDK/API workflows and favor SDK use over raw REST; they do include external upload, callbacks, listing, file retrieval, and deletion, but these are expected for transcription job management.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only Markdown documentation and references; no executable scripts, package installs, hooks, or automatic setup behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Sending local audio files, URLs, transcripts, and derived analysis to Gladia is proportionate to the skill's purpose, but users should treat the content as potentially sensitive third-party data sharing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, credential harvesting, or hidden data storage behavior was found in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before using this skill, confirm you are allowed to send the chosen audio, video, URLs, transcripts, metadata, and webhook callbacks to Gladia. Avoid regulated or confidential recordings unless your organization has approved Gladia's terms, retention, and compliance posture.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The privacy concern is valid as user guidance because audio and transcripts can contain sensitive data, but the external Gladia data flow is disclosed by the skill's purpose and is not hidden or unrelated behavior.
